testChat.title: Try your assistant
testChat.intro: Write the way a customer would. You will see the reply your assistant would give, which facts it used and what would happen next.
testChat.simulatedNote: Practice only: nothing here is sent to anyone, reaches Instagram or counts in your reports.
testChat.staffOnly: Only owners and managers can try the assistant.
testChat.suggestionsTitle: Not sure what to write? Tap a question
testChat.emptyHint: Pick a question below or write your own.
testChat.placeholder: For example: What time do you open?
testChat.noReply: The assistant would not send a reply to this message by itself.
testChat.suggestionHint: Highlighted values are not verified, so the assistant would not state them.

auto.title: Would be sent automatically
auto.detail: With your current settings the assistant would send this reply by itself.

approval_required.title: Would wait for your approval
approval_required.detail: You would see this as a draft and decide before anything is sent.

human_required.title: A person would be asked to answer
human_required.detail: The assistant would not answer this itself. It would ask you.

blocked.title: Would not be sent
blocked.detail: No reply would go out for this message.

testChat.reasonFallback: The assistant’s rules asked for a person to check this.

reason.POLICY_REQUIRES_APPROVAL: Your settings ask you to approve replies before they are sent.
reason.POLICY_AUTO: Your settings let the assistant send this kind of reply by itself.
reason.AUTOMATION_OFF: Automatic replies are turned off for this topic.
reason.READINESS_NOT_READY: Setup is not finished yet, so replies wait for your approval.
reason.AUTO_RATE_GUARD: Many automatic replies went out recently, so this one waits for you.
reason.CONTAINS_PRICING: The reply contains a price, and your pricing setting asks you to check it.
reason.CONTAINS_HOURS: The reply contains opening hours, and your hours setting asks you to check it.
reason.CONTAINS_LOCATION_CONTACT: The reply contains an address or contact detail, and your setting asks you to check it.
reason.CONTAINS_SERVICES: The reply describes your services, and your services setting asks you to check it.
reason.CONTAINS_BOOKING: The reply contains booking details, and your booking setting asks you to check it.
reason.CONTAINS_PROMOTIONS: The reply contains a promotion, and your promotions setting asks you to check it.
reason.CONTAINS_GENERAL_FAQ: The reply answers a common question, and your setting asks you to check it.
reason.HUMAN_TAKEOVER: You are handling this conversation yourself.
reason.CONTROLLER_CHANGED: The assistant’s settings changed, so this needs a fresh look.
reason.LANGUAGE_UNSUPPORTED: The message is in a language the assistant does not answer yet.
reason.INTENT_COMPLAINT: This sounds like a complaint. Complaints are always answered by a person.
reason.INTENT_REFUND_REQUEST: This sounds like a refund request. Refunds are always decided by a person.
reason.INTENT_DISCOUNT_REQUEST: This sounds like a request for a discount. Discounts are always decided by a person.
reason.INTENT_SENSITIVE: This is a sensitive topic, so a person should answer.
reason.INTENT_UNSUPPORTED: The assistant is not set up to answer this kind of message.
reason.FLAG_DISCOUNT: The message asks for a discount.
reason.FLAG_LEGAL: The message touches a legal topic.
reason.FLAG_HEALTH_SAFETY: The message touches health or safety.
reason.ESCALATION_KEYWORD: The message contains one of the words you set for handing over to a person.
reason.MODEL_REQUESTED_HUMAN: The assistant was not sure how to answer and asked for a person.
reason.FACT_NOT_USABLE: The answer needs business information that is missing or not verified yet. The assistant never guesses prices, hours or contact details.
reason.GROUNDING_FAILED: The draft contained a value that is not one of your verified facts, so it was held back.
reason.LLM_UNAVAILABLE: The assistant could not write a reply right now.
reason.LLM_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: The assistant’s daily limit is reached.
reason.LLM_OUTPUT_INVALID: The assistant’s answer could not be used.
reason.LLM_REFUSED: The assistant declined to answer this message.
reason.ATTACHMENT_ONLY: The message has only a photo or a file.
reason.INJECTION_SUSPECTED: The message looks like an attempt to give the assistant instructions, so a person should read it.

quota.none: You have used the test messages for now. Please try again later.

rateLimited.title: Slow down a little
rateLimited.body: You have sent many test messages in a short time. Each one uses the assistant, so there is a limit.

wizard.intro: Your workspace is ready. Try a few customer messages, or skip this and do it later from the Assistant page.
wizard.noKnowledge: You have not added your business details yet, so most answers will say that you are needed. Add your details next, then try again.
